title: Kotodama
summary: The instruction set and runtime for SORA Nexus smart contracts, compiled to deterministic bytecode that the IVM executes with predictable gas costs and typed inputs.
definition: The instruction set and runtime for SORA Nexus smart contracts, compiled to deterministic bytecode that the IVM executes with predictable gas costs and typed inputs.
tagline: Powers programmable logic on SORA without the unpredictability of Turing-complete VMs.
